children: Private equity firm Carlyle Group LP
and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development will sell their Romanian offshore natural gas producer Black Sea Oil & Gas (BSOG) to Mazarine Energy, BSOG said on Thursday.

BSOG launched Romania's first offshore Black Sea gas project in 2022, accounting for about 10% of the EU state's gas consumption. The sale is pending regulatory approval. Carlyle did not disclose the sale price.
